ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly polarized distribution; approximately 85% low-intensity (black) base pixels with 15% high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters forming high-contrast patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes. The interior surfaces show a stochastic distribution of white 'star-field' mottling and linear streaks against a continuous dark background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 15% of the total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5-12 pixels, with the most jagged topography located on the outer third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral S-curve; lobes exhibit moderate convexity near the median notch, transitioning to a slight concavity before reaching the irregular, widened distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) localized at the extreme distal tips and scattered across the central ventral region, consistent with high-contrast focal points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions; longest visible mark is a diagonal rake-like abrasion on the upper left lobe traversing approximately 40 pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white superficial scarring and irregular encrustations on the distal lobe margins; heavy distribution of circular and linear white markings across the dark ventral field.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density micro-spotting ('pin-prick' white pixels) distributed uniformly across the medial dark sections of both lobes.
